QuestInfo.name: Warm Bellflower Juice
QuestInfo.1: Bellflower juice is most effective when it is warm but the trainee who was hired part time to make deliveries have not shown up today. Go deliver Bellflower juice before it gets cold!
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the fresh warm Bellflower Root Juice.

0.0: It's here, it's here! Warm, juicy Bellflower Juice! The effects are strongest when they're fresh, so our store offers delivery service right to people's homes! But our part-timer had to take the day off to take care of his training injuries. Can you help me?

yes.0: There are 5 places you need to deliver to. One thing to keep in mind is you can't let the Bellflower Juice go cold. It takes about #r2 minutes#k for them to go cold, so please make your rounds before time's up!

no.0: To become a sage also means being kind to your neighbors.

1.0: You're faster than I thought. Even the part-time workers out here don't always make it back in time. You looking for a regular delivery job? It pays...okay.

yes.0: Thanks for your hard work. Here, have a sip of the Bellflower Juice. This will give you plenty of energy!

default.0: Please deliver all the Bellflower Juice before they go cold.
